title: Build an offline AI chat companion on a Raspberry Pi
summary: A founder with no hardware background says Claude Code helped build Hans, a keyboard-and-screen AI beaver running Gemma 4 offline on a Raspberry Pi 5.
agent_role: Claude Code guided and built the software and setup for the device; the human assembled the hardware and directed the project.
outcome: The author shows a working first version in a video: typing to Hans and getting answers on a screen with no internet.
what_they_did: The poster, who says they know nothing about hardware, used Claude Code to build Hans. Hans is a beaver-themed AI companion. You type on a keyboard and he replies on a screen. A small open model, Gemma 4, runs on a Raspberry Pi 5.
how_it_went: They share a video of the first working version answering typed messages fully offline.
prompt: I have a Raspberry Pi 5, a keyboard and a small screen, and no hardware experience. Help me build an offline chat companion called [name] with a [personality]. Pick a small open model that runs locally on the Pi, then walk me through setup step by step. Write the code for a simple text chat shown full-screen. Explain each command before running it, and ask before installing anything or changing system settings.

curation.rationale: A non-hardware person used Claude Code to build an offline AI companion device on a Raspberry Pi, shown in a video, but steps and details are thin.
